completionRule: signatureRecoveryCompleted may become true only after human operator completes and verifies the recovery flow with real values.
nonCompletionRule: If any value is missing, placeholder, unknown, mismatched, or unverified, signatureRecoveryCompleted remains false and downstream gates remain blocked.
nextRequiredAction: Human operator may later complete the actual completion receipt with real values only after recovery flow is actually completed and verified.
